one_liner: Explored applied AI and creative technology initiatives to support brand storytelling, internal workflows, and digital experiences.
projectSummary: Charles worked with Coca-Cola on a series of applied AI and creative technology initiatives, exploring how generative models and intelligent tools could support brand storytelling, internal workflows, and new digital experiences. His work focused on turning abstract AI capabilities into tangible prototypes that were understandable and usable by non-technical teams.

problem.summary: The team needed to move from abstract conversations about 'AI' to concrete, evaluable experiments that could demonstrate real value in creative and strategic workflows.

goals: Identify high-leverage use cases for applied AI in brand and creative contexts
Build prototypes that show how AI can support creative workflows
Make complex technical concepts accessible to cross-functional partners
Help stakeholders understand constraints and risks of AI implementations
Create patterns and mental models for applied AI at Coca-Cola
responsibilities: Collaborated with creative and strategy partners to identify AI use cases
Evaluated capabilities and tradeoffs of different AI models and approaches
Built prototypes and internal demos showing AI in creative workflows
Framed complex technical concepts in accessible language
Acted as bridge between AI research and brand/creative teams
outcomes: Enabled stakeholders to see how AI might support real workflows
Created concrete understanding of AI constraints and risks
Helped leadership make grounded decisions about AI directions
Established clearer internal language and mental model for applied AI
Delivered prototypes and patterns for future teams to build on
